goal: Implement a visual Stage & Activity Builder at /lessons/[id]/builder in dau-viet-admin: non-technical Content Admin creates/reorders/configures stages and typed activities through forms (no raw JSON), saves the structure as a backend-compatible draftJson via PUT /admin/lessons/{id}/draft, and reopens without data loss.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /lessons/[id]/builder opens from lesson detail; 3-pane workspace (stage navigator | editor | inspector) responsive-collapses on small screens.

Stage ops: add/rename/change-type/reorder/delete-with-confirm (duplicate if straightforward), required flag, nextStageIds via stage selectors — no manual UUID entry; only backend-verified stage types offered.
Activity ops: add/edit/reorder/remove inside a stage; type picker shows Vietnamese name + explanation + icon; only backend-supported ActivityType values selectable.

Typed editors for READ, VIEW_IMAGE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, EVIDENCE_SELECT, MATCHING, DRAG_ORDER, CER where backend schemas support them; remaining types show honest unsupported state; no invalid placeholder configs saved.

draftJson round-trip: load GET /admin/lessons/{id}, parse to typed models, save PUT /admin/lessons/{id}/draft with expectedRowVersion; unknown fields preserved; IDs stable across reorder/edit; published snapshots untouched.
Validation UX: field/stage/activity indicators + error list + save feedback + unsaved-changes guard + delete confirm; SAVE vs PUBLISH validation kept distinct — partial drafts saveable.
Semantics preserved: optional stages don't block completion, required activities consistent with parent, transitions reference valid IDs, no unsupported types emitted.
Template handling correct for empty draft / existing structure / template-based lesson; explicit 'Tạo cấu trúc từ khung bài học' action if backend doesn't instantiate — never silently replaces work.

Tests: builder flows (add/edit/reorder/delete, MC + DRAG_ORDER config, partial save, reload persistence, validation errors, published immutability) + Playwright authoring scenario vs controlled stub; stub never represented as real backend.
All gates pass (lint, tsc, vitest, build, playwright); Vietnamese UI throughout; no regression on TASK-0013/0014.

evidenceRefs: vitest 62/62 pass, 14 files (builder: draft-model 5, use-builder 10, multiple-choice-editor 3, builder-page 8)
playwright 8/8 pass incl. tests/e2e/builder.spec.ts 3/3 (controlled stub, not real backend)
tsc --noEmit clean; next lint 0 warnings; next build OK (builder route 21.4 kB)
